Address, City, State, or Zip code Find a Location # Occupational Therapy in Barrington, IL ![Regaining comfort and independence in Barrington, IL, with personalized occupational therapy at Athletico—helping residents overcome hand, shoulder, and upper extremity injuries so they can get back to gardening, community events, and enjoying local parks.](https://www.athletico.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/HandTherapy.jpg) Life in Barrington, IL is full of energy, whether you’re enjoying the crisp fall air at Citizens Park, working in your garden during our warm summers, or playing with your kids at Langendorf Park. From the changing seasons that invite us outdoors to the lively community events, Barrington offers countless opportunities to stay active and connected. But when shoulder pain, hand injuries, or difficulties with daily tasks start to slow you down, even the simplest pleasures can feel out of reach. That’s where Occupational Therapy comes in—a vital service at [Athletico Physical Therapy – Barrington](https://www.athletico.com/locations/barrington/) designed to restore your comfort, independence, and confidence, so you can fully embrace everything our vibrant community has to offer. ## What Is Occupational Therapy and Who Can Benefit? Occupational Therapy focuses on helping you regain the skills and strength needed for the activities that matter most—whether that’s returning to your job, cooking a favorite meal, or simply being able to button your coat as the Barrington winters set in. Our team of highly trained occupational therapists and hand therapists understands how important it is for you to feel capable and independent, especially as you navigate the unique demands of local life, from shoveling snow to swinging a golf club at Makray Memorial Golf Club. ## Specialized Hand and Upper Extremity Therapy In a community as active as Barrington, injuries and pain in the hands, wrists, elbows, and shoulders are all too common. Whether you’re a weekend gardener, a commuter dealing with repetitive strain, or someone managing the effects of arthritis, our specialized hand therapy and upper extremity therapy services are here to help. Our hand OTs (occupational therapists) are experts in treating: | | | --- | | - Shoulder pain and limited range of motion
- Wrist sprains, fractures, and repetitive strain injuries
- Hand and finger injuries, including tendon and nerve issues
- Post-orthopedic recovery for the upper extremities
- Arthritis management and joint protection strategies | Our goal is to help you regain strength, reduce discomfort, and restore function—so you can get back to everything from typing at work to playing catch with your kids in the backyard. ## Personalized Care for Your Unique Needs No two people are exactly alike, and neither are their therapy plans. At Athletico Physical Therapy – Barrington, we start by getting to know you—your goals, your lifestyle, and the specific challenges you’re facing. Whether you’re recovering from a sports injury sustained at a Barrington High School game, dealing with post-surgical stiffness, or simply hoping to improve your grip strength for gardening, your occupational therapist will create a personalized plan built around your needs. ### What to Expect During Your Occupational Therapy Journey Your path to recovery is supported every step of the way. Here’s what you can expect: | | | --- | | - A thorough assessment to understand your pain, strengths, and goals
- One-on-one sessions with your occupational therapist or hand therapist
- Hands-on techniques to relieve discomfort and promote healing
- Guided exercises to restore movement, build strength, and support daily activities
- Education on injury prevention and safe ways to return to your favorite Barrington activities | ## Why Choose Athletico Physical Therapy – Barrington? We’re proud to be part of the Barrington community, and our commitment goes beyond just treating symptoms. Our clinic is conveniently located, making it easy to fit appointments into your busy schedule—whether you’re heading home from work or dropping the kids off at school. We’re dedicated to providing accessible, expert care with a personal touch. Our occupational therapists and hand therapists are passionate about helping you reclaim your best life, using evidence-based techniques and a supportive approach every step of the way. ## Take the Next Step Toward Independence and Comfort Whether you’re looking for relief from shoulder pain, need specialized hand therapy, or want to overcome challenges in your daily routine, Occupational Therapy can help you rediscover the freedom and enjoyment you deserve. The team at Athletico Physical Therapy – Barrington is ready to support you—request an appointment today to begin your journey back to the activities and community connections you love most.
